en.title: Minimum Changes to Eliminate Adjacent Letter Conflicts
en.description:
Replace as few characters as possible so that any two adjacent characters are neither equal nor adjacent letters in the alphabet. Use only lowercase a to z; a and z are not adjacent.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string, 2≤length≤100000.
hints: Going from left to right, whenever you meet a conflicting edge, modify its right end and skip the edge immediately after it; continue from the next unprocessed edge.
